purpose: Primary-source discovery and future Iowa cancer modeling; not a prejoined causal dataset
verification_scope: Documentation/links and local archived headers inspected. Not every remote dataset downloaded or all file dictionaries exhaustively validated. Unverified endyears/access are explicitly marked.

local_status_definition.downloaded_query_extracts: Selected queries archived, not every possible table
local_status_definition.downloaded_2020_summary_outputs: 2020 summary risk outputs archived, not full block/concentration database
local_status_definition.report_only: Related report archived; full listed dataset not downloaded
local_status_definition.not_downloaded: Resource identified/verified, no data archive created
local_status_definition.report_indexed_download_blocked: Report indexed content available; download failed and HTML error retained

join_and_model_rules: Freeze each source's release date, data years, query, dictionary and original hash. Publication year, exposure year, diagnosis year and death year are separate fields.
Define cancer site, age, sex/race, stage, rate type, population and latency before joining. Incidence, mortality, survival, prevalence and projected counts are different endpoints.
Keep geography and residence time explicit. Diagnosis residence, death residence, workplace, water-service area, county farm production, ZIP, ZCTA, tract and custom zone are not interchangeable.
Use source IDs as text with leading zeros. Require a reviewed FRS/TRI/DNR crosswalk; do not infer shared identity from similar names or numeric-looking IDs.
Keep suppressed, unmeasured, not reported, below detection and zero separate. Preserve reporting limits, qualifiers, confidence intervals and unstable-rate flags.

Use chemical-specific units and matrices. Nitrate-as-N versus nitrate-as-NO3 differs by 62/14; do not convert without basis. TRI pounds/grams, DNR tons, air ug/m3 and water ng/L are not one common exposure score.
Do not add overlapping pollutant components or combine measured concentration, emitted mass and modeled risk as equal quantities. HAP is a regulatory list, not a uniform carcinogen category.

Use lagged exposure windows and sensitivity analyses chosen from biology/history. Current facility status cannot reconstruct 1980-2000 exposure, and county residence cannot reconstruct a worker's job history.
Age-adjusted rates are for comparison, not simple additive quantities. For modeling, obtain valid counts, age-specific denominators and uncertainty; avoid regressions on unstable rounded rates alone.
PLACES and CAMSA are modeled products. Their predictors/smoothing can induce associations and shared measurement structure. Do not treat predictions as independent validation or direct local trends.
TRI history is not yet a harmonized exposure panel. Sector/list/threshold changes, revisions, ownership, missingness and spatial relocation require explicit treatment before trend or health models.
An ecological association cannot identify an individual's cause or a facility's attributable cancer count. Negative or absent data are evidence gaps, not proof of zero risk.

resources.name: State Cancer Profiles
resources.geographic_coverage: US states and counties; Iowa 99 counties
resources.time_coverage: Archived live incidence 2019-2023; mortality 2020-2024. Trend intervals are distinct and query-specific.
resources.record_grain: Geography x cancer site x sex/race/age/stage filter x rate/trend window
resources.units: Cases/deaths per 100,000, average annual counts, AAPC percent, CIs/rank intervals
resources.access: Public CSV through output=1; preserve preamble/footnotes and exact query URL
resources.limitations: Suppression and unstable small-area rates; rank uncertainty; age adjustment. Search caches still display older 2018-2022. Incidence and mortality are different outcomes.
resources.intended_use: Primary comparable county/state summaries, subgroups, trends
resources.verification: Archived original query headers/footnotes inspected locally; source URLs retained in source-index.json

resources.name: USCS Data Visualizations downloadable tables
resources.geographic_coverage: United States/state and available county outputs
resources.time_coverage: June 2026 release; diagnosis years 1999-2023. CDC reports latest incidence 2023 and mortality 2024; inspect endpoint-specific file.
resources.record_grain: Preanalyzed geographic/demographic/site/year or pooled-period cell
resources.units: Counts; crude and age-adjusted rates per 100,000; intervals
resources.access: Public delimited ASCII/Excel packages; no case-level linkage to identify people
resources.limitations: Suppression/publication rules and registry coverage vary by year. Projected estimates are separate from observed registry cases. A release year is not diagnosis year.
resources.intended_use: Reproducible federal tabulations and cross-source comparison

resources.name: USCS public-use and restricted-access incidence databases
resources.geographic_coverage: Qualifying US registries; public-use does not provide county at diagnosis
resources.time_coverage: Current technical documentation 2001-2023
resources.record_grain: Cancer case record with permitted clinical/demographic variables
resources.units: Case-level coded variables; population denominators for rates
resources.access: SEER*Stat access/account/data agreement; restricted-access adds county and other fields through approved process
resources.limitations: Not an unrestricted patient download. Cases are tumors, not necessarily unique people. County cannot be assumed available in public-use data. No residential history or direct exposure variables.
resources.intended_use: Subtype/stage/demographic analysis after permitted access

resources.name: SEER Research and Research Plus
resources.geographic_coverage: SEER registry areas, including Iowa; not all US
resources.time_coverage: Nov 2025 submission/April 2026 documentation: 1975-2023; coverage depends on registry/database
resources.record_grain: Tumor/case record with registry, diagnosis, clinical and follow-up variables
join_keys: Patient/tumor IDs only within approved product
resources.units: Coded cases; survival; counts/rates using compatible populations
resources.access: Personal registration and data agreement. Research Plus requires eRA Commons/HHS authentication and additional eligibility. SEER*Stat is Windows software.
resources.limitations: Changing registry coverage; Research versus Plus variables differ; Iowa registry began 1973 but current standard research series says 1975 onward. No unauthorized cross-dataset identification.
resources.intended_use: Iowa longitudinal subtype/survival analyses with correct product and denominator

resources.name: Iowa Cancer Registry research/data request route
resources.geographic_coverage: Iowa residents at diagnosis; statewide registry since 1973
resources.time_coverage: Registry historical series since 1973; custom approved release determines end year; annual 2026 report includes 2026 projections
resources.record_grain: Registry cancer case and approved aggregate tables
resources.units: Cases, rates, clinical characteristics; annual projections separately labeled
resources.access: Public summaries; more detailed data require registry review/application and applicable privacy/research approvals
resources.limitations: Public reports do not substitute for case-level research data. Preserve observed versus projected. No direct download of identifying cases or implicit approval for linkage.
resources.intended_use: Best route for specific historical Iowa subtype/geographic questions
resources.verification: Official indexed report/research pages and Iowa HHS documentation verified; direct report download produced 403, not a valid archived PDF

resources.name: CAMSA and Iowa Cancer Zones
resources.geographic_coverage: Iowa county/ZIP-level CAMSA; Cancer Zones are purpose-built larger small-area aggregations
resources.time_coverage: CAMSA uses selected five-year case windows and annual updates; exact current window must be extracted from displayed/export metadata. Zones use fixed historical inputs, including 2015-2019 ACS on documented map.
resources.record_grain: Cancer site x geographic area x selected window; modeled/smoothed rates and uncertainty
resources.units: Age-adjusted estimated incidence per 100,000, risk probability, uncertainty
resources.access: Public interactive tools; indexed documentation accessible, direct UIowa requests intermittently 403
resources.limitations: ZIP is not automatically ZCTA. Smoothed estimates are not raw cases or independently observed rates. Uncertainty classes are ranked standard-deviation groups, not a uniform CI. Do not assume zone/year equivalence.
resources.intended_use: Generate small-area hypotheses with uncertainty and retrieve exact methods before modeling

resources.name: Iowa Public Health Tracking cancer data
resources.geographic_coverage: Iowa state and available local/demographic groups
resources.time_coverage: Portal documents 2000 through latest available; usually 3-4 year lag. Current end year must be read from actual export, not guessed.
resources.record_grain: Cancer site x residence geography x demographic group x year/window
resources.units: Case counts and rates per 100,000; small-count stability flags
resources.access: Public portal/linked site-specific pages; February 2023 source change to direct ICR
resources.limitations: Address at diagnosis only; no prior residence, smoking/diet or latency. Counts represent cancers, not unique people. 2000-2016 measures may differ after source change.
resources.intended_use: Iowa-specific official context and portal-defined comparisons

resources.name: CDC WONDER underlying-cause mortality
resources.geographic_coverage: US/state/county residence at death
resources.time_coverage: Current final Single Race series 2018-2024; older bridged-race series separate
resources.record_grain: Death count/rate cell by year, geography, cause and permitted demographic filters
resources.units: Deaths, crude/age-adjusted rates per 100,000, CI/SE where available
resources.access: Public query/export with data-use restrictions and suppression; preserve actual query
resources.limitations: Death certificates differ from incidence. 1-9 counts suppressed; current reliability/age-adjustment limits must follow current help, not older rules. Race-series/denominator comparability changes.
resources.intended_use: Cancer mortality and competing-cause context; verify county-rate availability

resources.name: USGS county agricultural pesticide-use estimates
resources.geographic_coverage: Conterminous US county estimates including Iowa
resources.time_coverage: Available 1992-2017 final plus 2018-2019 preliminary. Updated Aug 19, 2026 page plans final 2018-2022 inDec 2026, after this cutoff.
resources.record_grain: County x year x pesticide active ingredient x EPest-high/low
resources.units: Kilograms active ingredient/year in data releases; inspect each file dictionary
resources.access: Public release links/DOIs and tables; do not use superseded archived preliminary files as current
resources.limitations: Seed-treatment estimates discontinued beginning 2015. Agricultural use excludes many nonagricultural uses. High/low are estimation alternatives, not personal dose or guaranteed confidence bounds. USGS cautions against detailed specific-county comparisons.
resources.intended_use: Historical broad exposure hypotheses and latency-aligned sensitivity analyses

resources.name: USDA Census of Agriculture and NASS Quick Stats
resources.geographic_coverage: US/state/county; commodity-specific publication coverage
resources.time_coverage: 2022 most recent agricultural census; five-year censuses; annual survey series vary by commodity
resources.record_grain: County x year x commodity/practice/item/statistic/source
resources.units: Acres, farms, animals, production quantities, dollars and other explicit units
resources.access: Public tables/CSV/bulk; Quick Stats API requires key and query limits
resources.limitations: Disclosure suppressions such as D are missing, not zero. Animals/inventory/sales and capacity are different. County farm production is not personal pesticide exposure or residence-based employment.
resources.intended_use: Crop/livestock/practice context; acreage denominators and historical land-use covariates

resources.name: EPA TRI Basic Data Iowa history
resources.geographic_coverage: Iowa reporting facilities; selected sectors/chemical/reporting thresholds
resources.time_coverage: Downloaded 1987-2024, 38 annual files, 60,040 source records
resources.record_grain: Facility x chemical x reporting year/form; revisions and Form A/R matter
resources.units: Pounds for most chemicals; grams for dioxin-type entries; media-specific releases and waste management separate
resources.access: Public CSV; archived source manifests/hashes
resources.limitations: Nonreporting is not zero. Lists/thresholds/sectors/ownership change. Offsite transfers differ from onsite releases. Form A is unquantified certification. OSHA carcinogen flag is not IARC classification or potency.
resources.intended_use: Historical facility/agent/media inventory after harmonization

resources.name: EPA AirToxScreen
resources.geographic_coverage: National model; 2020 block outputs and population-weighted county/state summaries
resources.time_coverage: Archived 2020 cancer-risk results. Current landing page separately offers 2021 emissions/concentrations; do not assume 2021 risk release.
resources.record_grain: Geography x pollutant or source group x modeled assessment year
resources.units: Modeled lifetime cancer risk per 1 million; concentration units in specific files; hazard index separate
resources.access: Public downloads; local national workbooks and complete 99 Iowa county extracts
resources.limitations: Screening snapshot, not observed cases or annual incidence. Model/method changes prevent simple year-over-year trend. No quantified diesel-PM cancer contribution; no radon/most indoor/occupational pathways. Secondary chemistry is not facility attribution. Rounded totals need not equal displayed components.
resources.intended_use: Prioritize chemical/source/geographic follow-up with model limitations

resources.name: Iowa DNR Title V point-source inventory
resources.geographic_coverage: 283 Iowa Title V facility IDs
resources.time_coverage: 2024 emissions; actual PDF dated 2026-02-25 despite 2021 search metadata
resources.record_grain: Facility x emissions year; 9 pollutant-total columns
join_keys: Reviewed crosswalk to FRS/TRI/DNR site IDs
resources.units: Report labels tons/year without explicit short/metric definition; no conversion applied
resources.access: Archived PDF, complete 283 row CSV, reproduction script and provenance
resources.limitations: Not every Iowa source; excludes mobile, biogenic, nonpoint. HAPs include noncarcinogens and overlap VOC/PM. PM2.5 is a subset of PM10. Mass is not dose/risk. Do not add to TRI.
resources.intended_use: Facility coverage/process context and source-specific annual mass

resources.name: EPA AQS/AirData measured ambient pollution
resources.publisher: US EPA/state and local monitoring agencies
resources.geographic_coverage: Monitor sites, not continuous coverage; Iowa network varies by pollutant/year
resources.time_coverage: Historical/current hourly, daily, annual records; actual completeness/site periods vary; current year provisional
resources.record_grain: Site x parameter x POC x duration/method x time/standard/event treatment
resources.units: Parameter-specific units; preserve units, detection limits, qualifiers and completeness
resources.access: Public pregenerated files; AQS API key/email registration and query limits
resources.limitations: Sparse monitors and changed sites. Multiple standards, event rules, durations can produce multiple summary rows. AQI is not a cancer metric. 2021 Iowa carbonyl report/current 2026 network differ.
resources.intended_use: Measured ambient concentration series with QA and siting context

resources.name: UCMR occurrence data, especially UCMR 5 PFAS/lithium
resources.geographic_coverage: Sampled public water systems; UCMR 5 large/all mid-size and selected small systems; not private wells
resources.time_coverage: UCMR 5 scheduled 2023-2025 sampling; final dataset released Aug 2026. Older cycles 2001-2005, 2008-2010, 2013-2015, 2018-2020.
resources.record_grain: PWS x sampling location x sample event x analyte x analytical result
resources.units: Analyte-specific concentration units; preserve unit field. 1 ng/L = 1 ppt in water; 1 ug/L = 1000 ng/L.
resources.access: Public ZIP text, state ZIPs and Data Finder. Finder Excel limit 1 million records; whole All file exceeds Excel rows.
resources.limitations: Nondetect below MRL is not zero. Sampled detection is not household personal intake or a regulatory compliance determination. System address/county is not a service area boundary. Rounds differ in list/sensitivity.
resources.intended_use: Finished-water occurrence by chemical/system with sampling design
resources.verification: EPA final release/status verified; local Iowa PFAS reports are different datasets, not a downloaded UCMR 5 database

resources.name: SDWIS/Fed and ECHO drinking-water data
resources.geographic_coverage: Regulated public water systems and reported service areas; no private well census
resources.time_coverage: Quarterly/current federal snapshots; violation/date histories vary by system/product
resources.record_grain: PWS/facility inventory; violation/enforcement records; selected sample tables
resources.units: Population served, connections, categorical violations; concentration only where available
resources.access: Public reports/downloads; record extract/snapshot date
resources.limitations: EPA acknowledges underreporting/inaccuracies. Federal data do not contain all routine sample values. Monitoring violation is not chemical exceedance. System address is not complete exposure geography.
resources.intended_use: Public water identity, compliance history and crosswalk to UCMR/state actual samples

resources.name: Iowa Wells Information System
resources.geographic_coverage: Recorded Iowa private wells; location/depth/geology/water quality
resources.time_coverage: Historical records differ by well; active application current as of access
resources.record_grain: Well construction/location and associated sample/result records
resources.units: Well depth and analyte-specific concentration units; nitrate-as-N versus nitrate-as-NO3 must be identified
resources.access: Public map/query; public bulk/export capability not independently verified here
resources.limitations: Not a census of all wells or users; voluntary/targeted sampling and treatment status. Coordinates and repeated samples need QA. Raw well water versus drinking water tap are different.
resources.intended_use: Groundwater exposure hypotheses with geology/depth and sample dates

resources.name: Iowa HHS private well tracking summaries
resources.geographic_coverage: Iowa tested private wells; summarized state/county/local coverage as per portal
resources.time_coverage: 2000 through latest available according to docs; extract end year from actual export
resources.record_grain: Geography x year x analyte/test measure; underlying tested well records
resources.units: Tests, wells, percent above threshold; nitrate/arsenic concentration units depend on measure
resources.access: Public tracking portal; underlying PWTS microdata may need request
resources.limitations: Selection bias; repeated tests do not mean independent wells; tested wells are not all homes. Arsenic, nitrate, coliform measure different hazards; do not use bacteria as a cancer measure.
resources.intended_use: Document observed testing coverage and contamination indicators

resources.name: Radon zone maps and Iowa testing data route
resources.geographic_coverage: EPA county zone potential; lab/home tests where available through tracking/state program
resources.time_coverage: EPA zones developed 1993; home test date coverage varies; modern state testing microdata not downloaded
resources.record_grain: County zone or individual/aggregated building test; these are different data products
join_keys: County FIPS or proper geographic ID
resources.units: pCi/L or Bq/m3; 1 pCi/L = 37 Bq/m3; category zone is not measured concentration
resources.access: Public zone map; state/CDC aggregated test coverage; detailed Iowa testing export/access not verified
resources.limitations: All Iowa counties Zone 1 cannot explain between-county variation. Zone predicts potential, not individual home level. Tested homes not random sample; duplicates, short/long tests, season, mitigation matter.
resources.intended_use: Keep geologic potential separate from measured building exposure; identify data access gap

resources.name: USGS Water Data time-series and discrete Samples API
resources.geographic_coverage: USGS sites including Iowa surface/groundwater; location-dependent
resources.time_coverage: Historical to current measurements; NWIS discrete water quality froze March 2024; new/updated data use Samples API or new WQP
resources.record_grain: Site x time x parameter x method/qualifier; discrete sample versus continuous sensor
resources.units: Parameter-specific concentrations, streamflow and related units; preserve qualifiers and reporting limits
resources.access: Public modern APIs; migrate legacy waterservices/readNWIS code; current API limits docs
resources.limitations: Surface water/raw intake concentrations are not finished tap water. Frozen legacy endpoint can look current while missing new records. Different measurement media/methods/times must not be pooled blindly.
resources.intended_use: Historical water-pathway context and measured timelines with API provenance

resources.name: Iowa DNR animal feeding operations inventory/GIS
resources.geographic_coverage: Reported regulated Iowa livestock/poultry facilities; download metadata says active>= 300 animal units
resources.time_coverage: Live inventory snapshot; historical statuses/animal counts must be obtained separately
resources.record_grain: Facility/location x status/capacity/animal type; permit/construction records
resources.units: Head counts and animal units/capacity, not interchangeable; facility counts
resources.access: Public query/inventory reports and GIS downloads
resources.limitations: Small/unreported operations and historical closures may be missing. AFO, confinement, feedlot and EPA-CAFO definitions differ. Current capacity is not actual annual animal number, manure mass or personal exposure.
resources.intended_use: Exposure inventory with explicit definition/date; refine ecological livestock-density hypotheses

resources.name: EPA ECHO/FRS facility crosswalk/compliance
resources.geographic_coverage: Regulated facilities program-dependent, nationwide including Iowa
resources.time_coverage: Snapshot and program-specific history; keep data refresh date
resources.record_grain: FRS facility and program identifier; inspections/violations/enforcement events
resources.units: Categorical compliance, event dates, penalties; some emissions/discharge measures in separate tables
resources.access: Public download/web services; dataset-specific coverage
resources.limitations: One physical campus can have multiple program IDs or subfacilities. Fine amount and violation count are not cancer risk. No automatic name-only join; inspect aliases/location/period.
resources.intended_use: Join reviewed facility records across air/water/waste and dated enforcement

resources.name: EPA Risk-Screening Environmental Indicators (RSEI) and Geographic Microdata
resources.geographic_coverage: United States and territories, including Iowa. Air microdata use 810 m by 810 m receptor grid cells, with block-group, tract and ZIP aggregates; water microdata use downstream NHD flowlines. Receptors may be affected by sources outside their own county or state.
resources.time_coverage: Current verified data dictionary: version 2.3.12, TRI reporting years 1988-2022, released March 2024; TRI input snapshot frozen fall 2023. Do not infer RSEI coverage through 2024 from this project's newer raw TRI files. EPA download page offers 2020-2022 grid microdata; expanded 1988-2022 datasets can be requested.
resources.record_grain: Air disaggregated microdata: submission year x modeled chemical release/media x receptor grid cell, with concentration, toxicity-weighted concentration, score and population. Aggregated products sum releases over a receptor area. Facility, industry and release summaries are separate products.
join_keys: GridCode + X + Y for air receptor cells
ReleaseNumber, ChemicalNumber and FacilityNumber within the same version
TRI facility identifier through the corresponding Facility table
NHD flowline keys for water; documented geographic crosswalk and boundary vintage
resources.units: RSEI Score is unitless and relative; it incorporates surrogate dose, toxicity and population. Air Conc is modeled ug/m3. ToxConc is toxicity-weighted concentration; CTConc and NCTConc isolate cancer and noncancer weights. These are distinct metrics, not observed cancer cases or absolute lifetime probabilities.
resources.access: Public EasyRSEI browser dashboards, all-years dashboard, table CSVs and data dictionary. Geographic Microdata and crosswalk/shapefile directories are public; very large disaggregated national files can exceed 100 GB/year. Some expanded geographies/years require an EPA request. No request or large download performed here.
resources.limitations: Scores support screening and prioritization, not facility-specific causal findings, actual personal exposure or individual risk. Overall scores can combine cancer and noncancer effects. Verify stack parameters, location and chemical speciation; category toxicity may use conservative assumptions. TRI reporting limits and omitted sources remain. Do not combine RSEI model versions: internal keys and model results change; a consistent version recalculates historical years. Separate score changes caused by population, toxicity, modeling or input revisions from release changes.
resources.intended_use: Compare chemical-specific toxicity-weighted screening indicators and receptor areas within one model version; investigate high scores with refined exposure data. Avoid ranking cancer burden by raw TRI mass alone.
resources.verification: Official current-version page, dictionary, microdata documentation and public directory verified online 2026-10-22. Only documentation and directory listings read; no RSEI dataset downloaded.

resources.name: EPA National Emissions Inventory (NEI), including 2023 inventory
resources.publisher: US EPA with state, local and Tribal air agencies
resources.geographic_coverage: Nationwide including Iowa: point facilities, nonpoint county/tribal totals, onroad and nonroad mobile sources. Facility summaries and national/state/county sector summaries are separate aggregations; biogenics and fire supporting products require their own scope definitions.
resources.time_coverage: 2023 triennial inventory is publicly available at the October 22, 2026 cutoff; supporting-data page updated October 15, 2026 lists October 2026 data summaries. Full NEI releases every three years; intervening-year modeling platforms and facility summaries are different products. Freeze the exact release/revision and inventory year.
resources.record_grain: Annual emissions by source category and pollutant. Detailed point data may identify facility, unit, process/SCC and release point; nonpoint/mobile products aggregate by county/tribe, source category and pollutant. Facility-by-pollutant and sector/tier summaries must not be counted as additional emissions.
join_keys: EIS facility/site identifier and agency identifiers for point data
County FIPS or Tribal geographic code
Source Classification Code (SCC), EIS sector or tier definition
Reviewed crosswalk to FRS, TRI and DNR program IDs
resources.units: EPA units documentation specifies annual CAP/precursor emissions in short tons/year and HAP emissions in pounds/year. Preserve the actual product's pollutant and unit columns: summaries, modeling inputs and supplemental files can use different formats. Do not assume every column labeled emissions has the same unit.
resources.access: Public 2023 retrieval tool, facility mapping, custom county/sector/tier queries, zipped CSV summaries, SMOKE modeling inputs and technical documentation. National CSV packages are large and may exceed Excel capacity; select Iowa or a smaller summary. EIS Gateway has restricted agency/EPA access and differs from public downloads. No large download performed here.
resources.limitations: Estimated emissions inventory, not ambient concentration, personal dose or health risk. It blends reported data, factors, models and EPA augmentation; HAP completeness and method uncertainty vary. NEI uses TRI and other programs as inputs, so adding NEI to TRI or DNR totals can double count. CAPs, HAPs and particulate/speciation categories overlap. Historic comparisons need consistent methods, coverage and units. Current EIS facility names/IDs can differ from the frozen public inventory attributes; TSD notes public point reports generated April 15, 2026.
resources.intended_use: Broaden chemical/source coverage beyond TRI and Iowa Title V facilities, including mobile and nonpoint emissions; build a dated, pollutant-specific source inventory before exposure modeling.
resources.verification: Official 2023 landing page, October 2026 supporting-download page, units FAQ and 2023 technical documentation verified online 2026-10-22. No national or Iowa NEI data downloaded.

resources.name: BRFSS annual survey data
resources.geographic_coverage: State-representative adult telephone survey; Iowa included; local direct estimates limited
resources.time_coverage: Annual since 1984; current 2025 dataset released Aug 2026; question/module availability varies
resources.record_grain: Survey respondent x year with weights/strata/PSU and behavior/screening responses
resources.units: Weighted prevalence percent and survey responses; correct eligible population denominator
resources.access: Public ASCII/SAS XPT plus codebooks; national latest 356,158 records 284 variables
resources.limitations: Self report/nonresponse; cellphone/raking break 2011; module rotations/question changes; not county representative simply by assigning state values. 2025 excludes CA, MS, NV from national aggregate. Confirm actual included states from the selected data file/codebook; the annual webpage and Overview describe national participation differently.
resources.intended_use: Smoking, alcohol, obesity, screening and health access covariates with survey design

resources.name: PLACES small-area estimates
resources.geographic_coverage: County, place, tract, ZCTA adult small areas
resources.time_coverage: Current Dec 2025 release: 35 measures from 2023 BRFSS, 5 from 2022; ACS 2019-2023; county 2023 population
resources.record_grain: Geography x modeled measure x release/data-year/type
resources.units: Modeled crude/age-adjusted prevalence percent and 95% intervals; tract/ZCTA no age-adjusted estimates
resources.access: Public data.cdc.gov CSV/API/GIS-friendly files
resources.limitations: MRP modeled prevalence, not direct local observation or cancer incidence. Cannot reliably track local trend/evaluate local interventions using release changes. No individual inference. ACS may already be a model input: avoid circular covariate validation.
resources.intended_use: Cross-sectional context/prioritization, with model uncertainty and measure-specific vintage

resources.name: American Community Survey
resources.geographic_coverage: 1-year eligible large areas; 5-year all counties/tracts/block groups where tabulated
resources.time_coverage: Latest available 1 year 2024; 5 year 2020-2024 released Jan 29, 2026. 2025 one year estimates scheduled Oct 29, 2026, after cutoff; remaining 2025 products TBD.

resources.access: Public API/summary files/data.census.gov; variable metadata and annotations needed

resources.access: Public CSV/ZIP/Open Data; suppression and disclosure flags

resources.geographic_coverage: US/state/county/ZIP and other business geographies

resources.units: Establishments, March 12 reference-week employment, first quarter/annual payroll
resources.access: Public CSV/API; data index and dictionary per year

resources.access: Public ASCII/downloads; SEER Prep if needed for SEER Stat

resources.name: Census TIGER/Line and geographic relationship files
resources.geographic_coverage: State/county/tract/block/ZCTA and other published geographies
resources.time_coverage: Year-specific boundary releases; 2010-2020 relationship files; statistical geographies retain census vintage

resources.limitations: ZIP postal routes are not ZCTAs; zones not counties. No automatic one-to-one crosswalk. Area-weighted allocation of people/exposure can mislead; use population and geographic vintage appropriate weights. Centroid distance is not dose.
resources.intended_use: Safe geographic joins/crosswalks and explicit spatial exposure definitions
